rating.comments: The student makes no mistake: their claim that sound travels faster in water is correct, so both mistake dimensions are null. The AI confirms the first part of the claim, then asks 'why do you think that might be the case?' and points to properties of air and water, leaving the key reasoning to the student (supportive_guidance 4). The next step is relevant but not concrete and offers no way for the student to check their reasoning (next_step_guidance 3). The single reply is coherent but has no praise or warmth, so the tone is neutral (encouraging_tone 2).
